run_mesh_decomposition: run convex decomposition on 3D object meshes for a given dataset task and embodiment type
run_coacd_on_mesh: run the COACD algorithm on a visual.obj mesh file to decompose it into convex parts
export_convex_mesh_parts: export decomposed convex mesh parts as individual OBJ files to an output directory
update_task_info_convex_dirs: update the task_info.json file with paths to the newly generated convex decomposition directories
decompose_bimanual_meshes: decompose meshes for both left and right hands in a bimanual robot dataset task
